pattern: The referenced repository implements a Python command-line workload and mock-only execution; there is no HTTP service or equipment integration.
implication: Use a manually triggered Container Apps Job. Preserve mock-only authority and avoid public application ingress.

pattern: Five local source files have pinned names and SHA-256 identities. Dataset inspection is batch-oriented and model advice is optional.
implication: Use separate private Blob inputs and outputs with managed identity. Default to demo mode; dataset-analysis validates source identities before processing. Do not configure model credentials.

pattern: Initial planning lacked a known Azure target. The user identified the connected Douglas DME Systems account and approved the private foundation in rg-ai-command-gateway-dev, East US 2. Read-only inventory and a 39-create Provider preview preceded the successful deployment.
implication: Keep targets parameterized and preserve inventory, preview and deployed evidence. Use the existing-group workflow for later changes; keep image publication, source uploads and job execution separately scoped.

pattern: The user authorized local implementation and then the reviewed private Azure foundation. Engineering units, equipment limits and production acceptance remain unresolved.
implication: Record the successful foundation and read-only configuration checks without implying data-plane/runtime acceptance or operating authority. Keep the job disabled until its separate publication and execution conditions are satisfied.
